commentary.text: 91' Here comes a substitution. Eric Bailly (Villarreal) is brought on as a substitute for Thierno Barry.
90+8' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+8' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Betis was in an offside position.
90+7' Betis win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
90+6' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
90+5' Junior Reis leaps to intercept the corner kick from Isco (Betis).

90+5' Romain Perraud (Betis) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Betis will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+4' Good movement by Giovani Lo Celso (Betis), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
90+2' Isco swings the cross over. Romain Perraud (Betis) gets his head to it but it goes just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
90' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) plays a through ball but overhits it.
88' Betis have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
88' Antony (Betis) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. Betis force a corner. They send men into the box.
87' The defender did brilliantly to block the long-range effort from Isco (Betis).
86' Juan Pulido shows a yellow card to Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) for his blatant foul.
86' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
84' Antony (Betis) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Betis.
83' Thierno Barry (Villarreal) is penalised for a foul. Juan Pulido had a clear view and blows his whistle. Betis earn a free kick.
82' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball is out of play. Villarreal will have a throw-in.
81' Romain Perraud (Betis) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
80' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) sends a chip pass into the box, but Junior Reis is quickest to intercept the ball.
78' Marcelino has decided to substitute Dani Parejo and he is replaced by Willy Kambwala (Villarreal).
78' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) has picked up an injury and is replaced by Arnau Sola.
77' Romain Perraud (Betis) sends a cross into the box, but Junior Reis comes off his line to gather the ball.
76' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
75' Betis work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
74' Antony (Betis) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball is out of play. Betis win a corner kick.
72' The attendance for today's match is 54778.
72' Isco (Betis) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
71' Substitution. William Carvalho (Betis) in, Pablo Fornals out.
71' Manuel Pellegrini decides to make a substitution. Johnny Cardoso will be replaced by Sergi Altimira (Betis).
70' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Betis for a penalty. Play continues.
68' The Betis players can’t believe it after referee Juan Pulido signals NO PENALTY after the VAR review. Play to continue.
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Yeremy Pino departs the field of play to be replaced by Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal).
68' Marcelino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Denis Suarez (Villarreal) replacing Alfonso Pedraza.
65' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Betis! Let's see what he decides.
65' Logan Costa (Villarreal) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. Betis are awarded a penalty! What an opportunity to score.

64' That was a brilliant piece of goalkeeping! Junior Reis dived superbly to block a header by Cedric Bakambu (Betis) from around the penalty spot. His effort was directed straight towards the roof of the net, but Junior Reis pulled off a remarkable save!
63' Betis are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
61' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to make a change. Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) replaces Jesus Rodriguez.
61' It will be a substitution. Cedric Bakambu (Betis) is ready to enter the pitch as Cucho Hernandez walks off.
60' The resulting corner from Isco (Betis) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
59' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. Betis force their opponents to concede a corner.
59' Antony (Betis) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.

58' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger. The ball is behind the touchline and Villarreal will take a throw-in.
57' Antony (Betis) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
54' A clumsy foul by Aitor Ruibal (Betis) and Juan Pulido blows his whistle.
52' Junior Reis (Villarreal) picks up a yellow card.
51' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) receives a nice lofted pass and rips a snap shot from the edge of the box. His kick misses the goal and flies high over the crossbar.

50' What a great touch by Dani Parejo (Villarreal)! He picks up a precise pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot on goal. His effort, however, only rattles the right post. What an unlucky moment for him.
50' Johnny Cardoso (Betis) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
48' 1 - 2 Goal! Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) takes a short pass from Dani Parejo in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot low into the middle of the goal. 1:2.
47' The ball is out of play. Villarreal will have a chance to score from a corner.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+4' Antony (Betis) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
45+2' Betis are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Diego Llorente is being substituted because of an injury. Manuel Pellegrini sends Natan (Betis) on the pitch.
44' The game is interrupted now, Diego Llorente (Betis) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
43' Pablo Fornals (Betis) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
42' The Betis players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
41' Jesus Rodriguez (Betis) serves up a nice cross, but Junior Reis punches the ball away.

40' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) pounces on a great cross inside the box, but lashes his powerful first-time shot a whisker past the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
37' Antony (Betis) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Junior Reis, who smothers the ball.
35' Antony (Betis) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
34' Betis are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
32' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) gets on the end of a lofted pass near the penalty spot, but it's a poor header and drifts high over the bar.
31' Antony (Betis) takes the ball, nicely zig-zags through the defence, but his shot to the left post is smartly dealt with by Junior Reis.
30' Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
29' Juan Pulido blows his whistle for a foul after Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) hacks down one of his opponents. That's a free kick to Betis.
28' Betis are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
26' 1 - 1 Goal! Thierno Barry (Villarreal) fires the rebound inside the left post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:1.
26' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

26' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. Villarreal force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
24' Poor challenge! Santi Comesana (Villarreal) is penalised for tripping and Juan Pulido blows his whistle.
23' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
22' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Aitor Ruibal (Betis), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
20' Isco (Betis) received a pass out of defence and immediately attempted a long-range shot, but a defender bravely blocked the effort.
18' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
17' Jesus Rodriguez (Betis) unleashes a shot from long range but it's well blocked.
16' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
15' Isco (Betis) will deliver the corner kick.
15' Jesus Rodriguez (Betis) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Junior Reis comes off the line to clear the ball away. Betis win a corner.
13' Betis are awarded the free kick.
12' Thierno Barry (Villarreal) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Juan Pulido had an easy-decision to make.
11' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
10' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) plays a through ball but overhits it.
8' Juan Foyth (Villarreal) can count himself lucky for not being sent off after only receiving a caution from the referee.
8' Corner kick. Villarreal will have an opportunity.
7' The resulting corner from Dani Parejo (Villarreal) is cleared.
7' The ball is cleared after Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee points to the corner flag and Villarreal will take a corner.
5' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
